mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to determine the structure and arrangement of rock strata."
Geological survey is used to determine the structure and arrangement of rock strata.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for locating the station points by means of drawing rays from the stations whose locations have already been plotted on the sheet."
Resection Method The resection method is used for locating the station points by means of drawing rays from the stations whose locations have already been plotted on the sheet.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of steel or iron pieces of wire known as links which are joined together with circular or oval rings that make for flexibility."
A chain is made up of steel or iron pieces of wire known as links which are joined together with circular or oval rings that make for flexibility.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of a wooden or metallic rule of about 50-75cm day, with vanes at the ends."
Plain Alidade is made up of a wooden or metallic rule of about 50-75cm day, with vanes at the ends.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an instrument used to accurately determine the difference in elevation between two points on the earth's surface."
The level is an instrument used to accurately determine the difference in elevation between two points on the earth's surface.
fib: ______ is a piece of steel and iron of about .4 - .5 meters in length bent at the top into a circle and with a posited end allow for easy penetration into the ground.
An arrow is a piece of steel and iron of about .4 - .5 meters in length bent at the top into a circle and with a posited end allow for easy penetration into the ground.
______ is the compass bearing of a place taken from a status to the other in the direction that the survey is being carried out.
Fore bearing is the compass bearing of a place taken from a status to the other in the direction that the survey is being carried out.
______ is used to obtain accurate measurements, it is lighter to handle than the chain, and its length is not stretched due to usage.
The steel band is used to obtain accurate measurements, it is lighter to handle than the chain, and its length is not stretched due to usage.
______ is made up of 100 links and has a bran tag at every 10th link called a teller.
A typical chain is made up of 100 links and has a bran tag at every 10th link called a teller.
